Vintage style

Imperial Viscount Landaulette wedding cars

Two vintage-style cars, one in ivory and one in ivory and silver, each with a leather interior. The soft top lowers in seconds, so the car can be open or closed depending on the weather on the day. Book one, or both together.

PaintworkOne ivory; one ivory and silver (our latest addition)
InteriorCream leather in the ivory car, ivory leather in the ivory and silver
RoofSoft top that lowers in seconds
PassengersUp to 7 in each
